summary: Implementation plan for AstroShot: an advanced astrophotography assistant app featuring shoot planning, camera calculation tools (500 Rule, NPF Rule, Star Trails, Timelapse, Field of View), live weather and cloud layer forecasting (Open-Meteo), aurora Kp-index and oval predictions (NOAA/open data), moon phase tracking with illumination & golden/blue hour ephemeris, and a red night-vision mode for dark sky field sessions.
